video_title: 2026-27 Training Camp Media Availability 🎙️ | Justin Edwards | 10.02.26

quotes.speaker: Justin Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Justin Edwards on learning from new 76ers teammates KCP and Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: trying to learn from the new guys on the team, especially KCP and Joel Embiid
quotes.quote: Honestly, I am just trying to pick up where I left off and trying to learn from the new guys on the team, especially Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and Joel Embiid. We are all being competitive, all trying to push each other to be better. I feel that is what it is all about in training camp.
quotes.social_post: Justin Edwards says he is focused on learning from veterans Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and Joel Embiid during training camp to push his development.

quotes.speaker: Justin Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Justin Edwards on learning defensive schemes from Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.excerpt: I have been learning from Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, especially on the defensive end
quotes.quote: I have been learning from Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, especially on the defensive end. He is known as a defender, so I was just asking him certain questions like how he switches up his guarding schemes for different players. That is honestly it.
quotes.social_post: Justin Edwards is picking the brain of Kentavious Caldwell-Pope to improve his defensive versatility and learn how to switch up guarding schemes.

quotes.speaker: Justin Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Justin Edwards on learning post defense from Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: if I am able to guard him in the post, I feel like I will be able to guard
quotes.quote: I am learning how to guard different players. Joel Embiid is one of the best players in our league right now, so if I am able to guard him in the post, I feel like I will be able to guard a little bit of everybody. I am just trying to learn from him, learn from Phil, and that is really it, just learning for me.
quotes.social_post: Justin Edwards believes that if he can learn to guard Joel Embiid in the post during practice he will be prepared to defend anyone in the league.

quotes.speaker: Justin Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Justin Edwards on the surreal experience of playing with LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: it is crazy that I have LeBron James on my team
quotes.quote: He is my teammate now, and I am going on my third year. I am not really starstruck, but it is crazy that I have LeBron James on my team. Not a lot of people can say they were able to play with LeBron. He got drafted six months before I was born, so that is crazy.
quotes.social_post: Justin Edwards reflects on the surreal reality of being teammates with LeBron James noting that James was drafted six months before he was even born.

quotes.speaker: Justin Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Justin Edwards on the consistency and work ethic of LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: whatever he does the day before, he continues to do it
quotes.quote: He is consistent. Whatever he does the day before, he continues to do it. Preparation is the biggest thing. Whatever he does, he is going to do it with 110% effort.
quotes.social_post: Justin Edwards highlights the preparation of LeBron James saying he approaches everything he does with 110 percent effort.

quotes.speaker: Justin Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Justin Edwards on the impact of coach Nick Nurse on his development
quotes.excerpt: Nick Nurse sees little things and he will yell it out
quotes.quote: He is everywhere, especially with me and my jump shot. He sees little things and he will yell it out. Just being around him, having conversations, learning from him, and being in the workouts with him is great.
quotes.social_post: Justin Edwards says Nick Nurse is very hands on with his development specifically when it comes to refining his jump shot.

quotes.speaker: Justin Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Justin Edwards on the personality of Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: Joel Embiid is probably one of the most funniest people on our team
quotes.quote: I always tell people that Joel Embiid is probably one of the most funniest people on our team. He is hilarious.
quotes.social_post: Justin Edwards says Joel Embiid is one of the funniest people on the 76ers roster.
